treatment.name: Crowns & Bridges
treatment.overview: Crowns protect and restore damaged teeth; bridges replace missing teeth by anchoring to adjacent teeth or implants.

types.name: Zirconia/All-Ceramic Crown
description: Ideal for front teeth and metal-free preference.

types.name: Traditional Bridge
description: Replaces a missing tooth using crowns on adjacent teeth.

cost.note: Price varies by material, tooth location, and lab selection.

during: Temporary crown, then final crown/bridge fit and cementation.
after: Home-care and floss-threader demo for bridges.

avoid: Very sticky foods that may dislodge a fresh temporary
prefer: Chew on the opposite side until final cementation

pros: No tooth preparation cost/time if a crown isn’t placed
cons: Weak, cracked, or RCT tooth may fracture irreparably
Missing tooth space leads to shifting and bite problems
prosConsOfSkipping.summary: Crowns and bridges restore function, protect teeth, and improve appearance.

faq.a: Typically 10-15 years or more with good hygiene and bite habits.

faq.q: Can I whiten a crown later?
faq.a: Crowns don't whiten—choose your shade before fabrication.
